definitions.explanation: What a company spends to push sales of a product: campaigns, samples, in-store displays, coupons, and similar activity. A shortening of {販売促進費|はんばいそくしんひ}, and treated as a distinct line item in a budget.

examples.japanese: {販促費|はんそくひ}を{削|けず}ることになった。
examples.english: It was decided to cut the sales promotion budget.

examples.japanese: {今年度|こんねんど}の{販促費|はんそくひ}は{昨年度|さくねんど}より{多|おお}い。
examples.english: This fiscal year's promotional budget is larger than last year's.

examples.japanese: {新商品|しんしょうひん}の{販促費|はんそくひ}として、{三千万円|さんぜんまんえん}が{計上|けいじょう}された。
examples.english: Thirty million yen was budgeted as promotional expenses for the new product.

examples.japanese: {売上|うりあげ}が{伸|の}びなかったのは、{販促費|はんそくひ}の{使|つか}い{方|かた}に{問題|もんだい}があったからだ。
examples.english: Sales did not grow because there was a problem with how the promotional budget was spent.

notes:
An abbreviation of {販売促進費|はんばいそくしんひ}. The short form is what appears in budget spreadsheets and internal discussion; the full form is used in formal accounting documents.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {販促費|はんそくひ}を{削減|さくげん}する: to cut promotional spending
- {販促費|はんそくひ}をかける: to spend money on promotion
- {販促費|はんそくひ}を{計上|けいじょう}する: to budget for promotional expenses

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {広告費|こうこくひ}: advertising expenses — money spent on ads themselves, a narrower category
- {経費|けいひ}: business expenses — the general term covering all company spending
